topStories.headline: TSMC Delivers Record Q2 Earnings but Shares Fall 4%+ on AI Valuation Concerns
topStories.summary: TSMC reported Q2 net income up 77.4% YoY to NT$706.56B on $40.2B revenue — a fifth consecutive record quarter — while CEO C.C. Wei pledged an additional $100B Arizona investment bringing total US commitments to $265B, yet shares dropped as investors questioned whether AI chip valuations can be sustained.
topStories.marketImpact: TSM ↓ 4%+; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ↓; Nasdaq 100 ↓ 1.6% Thursday; AI trade under pressure globally.

topStories.headline: Netflix Slumps 8%+ After-Hours on Q2 Revenue Miss and Slowing Q3 Guidance
topStories.summary: Netflix reported Q2 revenue of $12.56B (up 13% YoY but slightly below estimates) and guided Q3 growth at 12% — a second consecutive quarter of decelerating sales growth — while narrowing full-year revenue guidance to $51–51.4B.
topStories.marketImpact: NFLX ↓ 8%+ after-hours; streaming deceleration thesis gaining traction; growth stock sentiment cautious heading into Friday.

topStories.headline: US Strikes Iran Again as Brent Crude Holds Near $87; Strait of Hormuz at Risk
topStories.summary: The US launched fresh military strikes on Iran and revoked oil sanctions waivers; three commercial vessels were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, halting tanker transits, with Iran signalling it may use Houthi allies to also block the Bab el-Mandeb strait.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ ~$87/barrel (4th consecutive day of gains, +9% above pre-conflict levels); energy stocks ↑; Treasury yields ↑ on inflation fears; equities ↓.

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Stays Hawkish After June CPI Cools to 3.5%; September Hike on the Table
topStories.summary: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh testified that June inflation falling to 3.5% from 4.2% is 'not mission accomplished'; nearly half of FOMC members now forecast another rate hike this year, with Goldman Sachs pushing rate cut expectations to 2027.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-sensitive sectors ↓ (real estate, utilities); US 10Y yield ↑ to 4.57%; US 30Y ↑ to 5.09%; growth tech under pressure; TLT ↓.

topStories.headline: China June Exports Surge 27% — Strongest Annual Gain Since 2021 on AI Hardware Demand
topStories.summary: China's exports rose a record 27% YoY to $412.39B in June, driven by booming global AI semiconductor demand and exporters front-running anticipated US tariffs; imports jumped 36% to an all-time high, widening the trade surplus to $125.62B.
topStories.marketImpact: Positive for Chinese manufacturers and logistics; trade surplus expansion may revive US tariff threats ↑ watch; 9988.HK resilient.

topStories.headline: Shein Wins CSRC Approval for $40–50B Hong Kong IPO Targeting September Launch
topStories.summary: China's securities regulator CSRC approved Shein's plan to list up to 341.6 million shares (~8% of total) on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, with a September–October IPO targeted at a ~$40–50B valuation — well below its $100B 2022 peak.
topStories.marketImpact: HK IPO pipeline ↑; 0388.HK (HKEX operator) ↑ watch; fast-fashion/retail sector attention; valuation discount reflects regulatory and geopolitical overhang.

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 Falls 2.8% as Kioxia Crashes 15% and SoftBank, Tokyo Electron Slump
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.79% to 66,835 on Thursday as the global semiconductor selloff hit AI-exposed Japanese names hard — Kioxia Holdings off 15%, SoftBank Group off 5.9%, Tokyo Electron off 5.2%, Advantest off 5.1% — the four names alone stripping 1,300+ index points.
topStories.marketImpact: 6600.T ↓ 15%; 9984.T ↓ 5.9%; 8035.T ↓ 5.2%; 6857.T ↓ 5.1%; TOPIX outperformed Nikkei; yen safe-haven demand a watch for USD/JPY.

topStories.headline: South Korea KOSPI Plunges 7%+, Triggers Circuit Breaker; SK Hynix Falls 11%
topStories.summary: South Korea's KOSPI triggered a circuit breaker as the AI chip selloff accelerated; SK Hynix tumbled over 11% and Samsung Electronics fell sharply — the two stocks together account for more than half of the index's total market value.
topStories.marketImpact: 000660.KS ↓ 11%+; 005930.KS ↓; KOSPI circuit breaker activated; broader Asian tech sentiment ↓; Korean won under pressure.

companiesToWatch.name: Netflix

companiesToWatch.name: Kioxia Holdings
companiesToWatch.reason: Crashed 15% in Thursday's Tokyo session as the AI chip selloff hit Japan's largest flash memory maker hardest; sentiment fragile heading into Friday.

companiesToWatch.name: SoftBank Group
companiesToWatch.reason: Down 5.9% as AI infrastructure concerns mount; Vision Fund's deep AI bets face re-rating risk if the valuation debate deepens.

companiesToWatch.reason: Direct beneficiary of Brent crude's return to $87/barrel; Iran conflict premium unlikely to fade with two critical shipping lanes now threatened.
